memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Obesity
  - Status: Weight 92 kg, waist 102 cm (>90 cm cut-off for men).
  - Plan: Continue orlistat 120 mg with each main meal (1-1-1 pattern, after food). Diet: breakfast – high‑protein, low‑glycemic; lunch – mixed vegetables with lean protein; dinner – light soup and salad. Reinforce daily 30‑min walk.
- Psoriasis
  - Status: Plaques 3‑4 % BSA, mild scaling, no new lesions.
  - Plan: Continue clobetasol 0.05% cream BD (0-1-0, after food) on affected areas; calcipotriol ointment OD (1-0-0, after food); methotrexate 7.5 mg once weekly (0-0-1, after food) with folic acid 5 mg OD (1-0-0, after food). Monitor LFT, CBC, creatinine in 4 weeks.
- Glaucoma
  - Status: IOP right eye 18 mmHg, left eye 19 mmHg; visual field full; optic disc cup‑disc ratio 0.3.
  - Plan: Continue timolol 0.5% eye drops BD (0-1-0, after food); latanoprost 0.005% eye drops HS (0-0-1, after food). Repeat IOP and visual field in 3 months.
Due: HbA1c due 2025-07-05.

- Obesity

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Referral to Rheumatology, Bangalore General Hospital.
Reason: Evaluation for possible psoriatic arthritis – patient reports morning joint stiffness, elevated psoriasis activity.
Please assess joints, consider DMARD optimization, and advise on NSAID use if needed.
Send reports back to Dr Karthik Hegde, Endocrinology, Sunrise Family Clinic.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Rheumatology review:
- Mild synovitis of MCP joints 2‑3 bilaterally, no erosions on X‑ray.
- Diagnosis: Early psoriatic arthritis.
- Recommendation: Continue methotrexate 10 mg weekly; add folic acid as prescribed.
- Add ibuprofen 400 mg PO TID after food for pain as needed.
- Monitor LFT and CBC every 3 months.
- Follow‑up in 8 weeks.
Reports attached.
